answer: Give the epoch a backbone: Ink grinder ink cake proof ground at the soot loft, proved by each ink cake is a season of logged grind tests plus a signed vat record, checked by strangers. The trail is short enough to follow by hand and long enough to catch a farm. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 35 minutes per proof, 10080 minutes for 288, due every single epoch. The farm practised the violet, it practised the umber, but it never practised the saffron, because a year cannot be practised.
